$comment: EXP-1560 (was A-16): THE Devices page, one spec ×4 (web my-machines.tsx + device-logins.tsx, desktop machines.rs, iOS AgentsView + DeviceLogins, Android AgentsScreen). LAYOUT: each section (`mine` with its `+ Add device` pill, `team`) is a GRID of device CARDS: columns = max(1, floor((width + card.gap) / (card.minWidth + card.gap))) over the section's content width, gap `card.gap` both ways (a phone in portrait gets 1 column, a phone in landscape or a tablet 2 or more). Groups: online cards first in the list's own order, then the muted `offline` label spanning the grid, then every offline card in its own grid, dimmed (opacity 0.6). CARD = THE GlassCard surface (fill + hairline + radius), padding `card.padding`, two rows. TOP row: left a column of [name (truncates) + `v{version}` beside it (warning tone when the caller's own device is outdated, else muted) + the default star] over [the status line (Online dot / Last seen …) + the `This device` / `Shared` tags]; right the `⋯` overflow (a ghost icon button, `copy.deviceActions`) opening THE Menu. Menu items, in order: the update line (when the device has an `update` / `update_queued` attention item: its `text` as a disabled muted row), `Update` (only when that item's action is `update`; busy while requested), `copy.settings` (own REGISTERED devices; opens the Device settings dialog). A team device's menu holds only a team owner's `copy.removeFromTeam`; a card with no item draws no `⋯` (its slot stays empty). BOTTOM row: the logins as ICONS ONLY, in `sortDeviceLogins` order: each a ghost icon button (`card.iconSize` square) holding the agent's brand mark (`card.markSize`), THE run-mark badge (AgentRunMark `needs_input`: amber dot top-right, ringed in the card's ground) ON every login that has a `login` attention item. With more than `card.maxAccountIcons` logins only the first maxAccountIcons-1 show, then a ghost `⋯` (`copy.moreAccounts`) that reveals the rest in place (`accountIcons`). Own, online cards with an agent to add end the row with a ghost `+` (`copy.addAccount`). A device that reported accounts but holds NO login says `noAccount` muted in the row; one that never reported says `checking`. EXP-1626 PERSIST LOGIN (replaces the EXP-1600 long-lived default and the long-lived Add): every sign-in (Add account, Sign in, the MCP `account_login`) is the agent CLI's normal BROWSER login, which names the account (email), reads every usage window (5h, weekly, per-model) and makes the profile; the sign-in dialog carries no mode line and no mode button. `copy.persistLogin` is an OPTION on an EXISTING signed-in claude login only (the account menu; the hover card pill only for the yearly reminder): it queues `agent_login {agent: claude, profileId, longLived}` for THAT profile, the same link + code-paste dialog with `copy.persistNote` as its one muted line; the machine runs `claude setup-token` in a fresh staging dir (never inside the profile, so the browser login it holds is never touched) and attaches the one-year token to the profile (`tokenExpiresAt`); nothing is typed or named. Once persisted, the profile's RUNS spend the token, and the browser login's refresh only feeds usage, so the two never rotate each other out. The usage keeps coming from the browser login while it is valid; when its refresh grant dies, the token keeps runs working and the usage falls back to the token's weekly window (the device reports the profile's `usageSource: "token"`). WHICH ONE IS ACTIVE: the preview header of a profile with `tokenExpiresAt` shows one muted line under the plan: `copy.persistedToken` when `usageSource` is `token`, else `copy.persistedBrowser`. With a token, the menu offers `copy.renewPersistedLogin` (same queue) instead of `copy.persistLogin`. Codex has no setup-token: neither option. Closing the sign-in dialog before the login lands queues `agent_login_cancel {agent, loginCommandId}`: the machine stops that run (its child is killed and its staging dropped) unless a code was already handed to it; a run nobody finishes is stopped by the machine itself 10 minutes after it started. ACCOUNT PREVIEW: hovering an icon (pointer) opens THE hover card; a click (pointer) or a tap (touch) opens THE account menu (AccountChipMenu, in order: `Sign in` when signed out or needs_relogin (the browser login); claude only and only when it does NOT sign in: `copy.persistLogin` without a token, `copy.renewPersistedLogin` with one; `Sign out` when signed in; `Remove account` always; a team device's icon only previews, a tap opens the preview card). Both lead with the SAME header: the email (else the label) on top, the plan muted under it, the persisted line (see PERSIST LOGIN) under that, the login's `status` line in warning tone when it has an attention item, then the usage windows (UsageWindows `full` density: title + reset, then meter + percent: the 5h session, the weeks, the per-model windows, each with its reset; only the windows the login REPORTS: a login whose usage comes from its persisted token reports the weekly window alone, and no empty 5h row is drawn for it). The hover card ends with a pill for the item's action: `sign_in` = `copy.signIn`, `keep_signed_in` (status `renew`) = `copy.renewPersistedLogin`, which opens the persist sign-in for that profile. ATTENTION (pure, `deviceListRow`): items in order: every login whose health is needs_relogin, then every signed_out login, then every OTHER login with `limitHit` (a fresh usage window at ≥ 100%; text `limitReached`, never an action), then (own devices only) every OTHER claude login whose `tokenExpiresAt` is within `keepSignedIn.renewWithinDays` days of `now` or past it (text `renewSoon`, status `renew`, the yearly reminder; action `keep_signed_in` only on the caller's own online device; a login WITHOUT a token is never an item: persisting is an option, not a prompt), then the update line. A login yields at most one item. An AGENT with no login at all (a CLI installed, never signed in: `profiles` empty or absent) is NOT an item and badges nothing: the old IDE bug where mint read `Signed out` because Codex was installed. The update line exists only on the caller's own device: `updateQueued` when an update is parked behind live sessions (no action), else `updateAvailable` (with `latest`) when the client's own version compare says `outdated` (action `update` only for a SERVER — the CLI daemon is the one device that acts on an update request; a desktop app updates itself — and only while it is online and registered). Login actions (`sign_in`, never on a limit item) only on the caller's own online device. Team devices: read-only (no `+`, no actions), a team owner's Remove in the `⋯`.

copy.longLivedRefused: A long-lived login needs a Claude account on this machine.
copy.persistNote: Persist login keeps this account's runs signed in for 1 year, even if its browser login expires. We remind you to renew.
copy.persistedBrowser: Persisted · usage from the browser login
copy.persistedToken: Persisted · browser login expired, weekly usage only
